clips.title: The story
paras: Master Mechanic Castpipe is calling capable travelers to Ironforge. He needs help recovering records from the ruined halls of Gnomeregan, where vital mechanical and technical knowledge remains trapped.

After Gnomeregan fell and was placed under radioactive quarantine, its surviving gnomes took refuge in Ironforge's Tinkertown. Troggs and irradiated constructs still overrun their great home. Deep in the city, computing arrays hold operational records and mechanical schematics. Master Mechanic Castpipe is enlisting outsiders willing to brave the toxic halls and recover files that may help explain what went wrong or aid a return to Gnomeregan.

Gaxim Rustfizzle, of the Enlightened Assembly of Arcanology, Alchemy and Engineering Sciences, spreads word of Castpipe's effort. Castpipe does not belong to the academic body, but fellow gnomes respect his technical skill and support his work. Rustfizzle calculates an eighty-four percent chance that the operation has strategic value. Travelers can report to Tinkertown for orders.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Master Mechanic Castpipe in Ironforge has need of adventurers! He's organizing bands to reenter Gnomeregan on a data retrieval mission of top security and importance.

Castpipe might not be a member of the Enlightened Assembly of Arcanology, Alchemy and Engineering Sciences like I am, but he's still a smart gnome so if he thinks it's important, then by my calculations there's an eighty-four percent probability that it really is important!

clips.title: Completion
paras: I'm organizing data extraction missions into Gnomeregan. If you're here for that, then listen up!
